applicant_utility: Worth about NZ$27,000 in kind, this is the strongest first-year undergraduate award at the University of Auckland, but read the terms carefully: the money is not paid to you in cash. Roughly NZ$22,000 of it is a year of catered accommodation in a University of Auckland Hall of Residence, with about NZ$5,000 left over for your own use. If you would rather live in private flats, ask the scholarship office whether the accommodation component can be converted before you commit. With up to 250 awards on offer each year the odds are genuinely reasonable, so it is worth applying even if your grades are not perfect, provided you can also show a real record of leadership or community involvement outside the classroom. The 2026 round closed on 12 August, so diarise late June or July if you are aiming at the September 2027 intake and keep an eye on the scholarship search page for when the new window opens.

applicant_utility: The Vaka Moana award is aimed specifically at students entering Auckland on New Zealand school-leaver qualifications, so if you did your Year 13 at a New Zealand school this is one of your strongest first-year options. Like the Top Achiever Scholarship, the headline figure is mostly housing rather than cash: about NZ$24,000 in total buys you a year of catered accommodation in a University hall of residence plus a laptop. Because the number of awards varies from year to year, treat it as a bonus rather than your financial plan and still investigate need-based grants, StudyLink fees and living cost support, which can run alongside this scholarship. Applications for the 2026 round closed on 12 August at midday, so watch the Auckland scholarship search page from late June onwards for the 2027 window.
